strings.mdKbSmart: • Sanduuqa furaha Smart soo qaado: waxa uu ka hubiyaa sanduuqa furaha ee hadda jira liiska Google ee liiska burinta (CRL) waxa uuna isku dayaa ilo badan ilaa uu ka helayo sanduuqa furaha oo sax ah, isaga oo wata kayd toos ah iyo dib u bilaabaya adeegyada Google. Ku shaqeeya tuubo kasta oo u baahan internet (1-3 daqiiqo).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ka network: ka soo dejisan sanduuqa furaha kaydka rasmiga ah (GitHub) wuxuuna ku kaydiyaa /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Wuxuu u baahan yahay internet wuxuuna qaadanayaa 1-3 daqiiqo. Waxaa la adeegsadaa marka soo-dejinta smart-ka ah uu fashilmo ama marka sanduuqa furaha gacanta lagu beddelay.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ogaanshaha: wuxuu hubiyaa qaybaha Bixinta Furaha Fog ee jira, wuxuu eegayaa TEE nooca shahaadaynta, oo wuxuu tusinaa qalabka KmInstallKeybox. waxba ma beddelo - muuqaalka heerka qalabka cad.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine jeeg (akhri-kaliya): waxay tusinaysaa Widevine tilmaamayaasha heerka (L1/L3) ee qashinka, DRM (IDM) joogitaanka faylka furaha, iyo guryaha la xidhiidha nidaamka. Waxba ma beddelo haba yaraatee.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Buugga RKP hagaajin: socodsiiya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh buug-gacmeedka. Waxay hagaajisaa arrimaha caddaynta marka kaarka tooska ah uu guuldareysto. Orod kastaa wuxuu daabacaa khad guul / guul darro cad ah.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP hagaajin: socodsiiya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh buuxa. Waxay qabataa kiisaska adag waxayna qaadataa waqti dheer. Natiijo cad ayaa soo baxaysa dhamaadka
strings.mdGmsReset: • Dib u habayn GMS: waxay nadiifisaa Play Store iyo Google # adeegyada (GMS+GSF) oo si toos ah dib ubilaabay qalabka. Caddayn madax adag oo keliya - waligeed ma taaban sawiradaada ama faylashaada.
strings.mdCertify: • Ciyaarta shahaadada: waxay hubisaa RKP heerka caddaynta qalabka oo dib u dajinaysa sifooyinka caddaynta haddii loo baahdo. Ma taaban xogta isticmaalaha
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER dayactirka: hagaajinta Google adeegyada qaab-dhismeedka (SOTER) arrimaha la xidhiidha marag-kaca qalabka. Loo isticmaalo aaladaha qaar ee ku tiirsan SOTER halkii Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: Codso PIF: wuxuu wadaa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh xoog. Ku dabaqa sawirka faraha la doortay (maxali ah/sare) oo cusboonaysiiya faylasha pif.prop/pif.json. Natiijo cad ayaa ka muuqata log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF jeeg: waxay tusinaysaa heerka mishiinka ku rakiban yahay, faylasha faraha (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), iyo logyada. Hubi kaliya - waxba ma beddeleyso.
strings.mdCanary: • Cusboonaysiinta Canary: wuxuu wadaa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Soo saarta sii deynta Canary Engine ee ugu dambeysay si loo hubiyo in ay waafaqsan tahay shahaadooyinka RKP ee qasabka ah (Febraayo 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Cilad-sheegidda mishiinka: waxay hubisaa gobolka TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), feylasha sanduuqa furaha (active vs user), faraha qalabka dhabta ah vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP furayaasha. Muujinta ogaanshaha kaliya.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module-ku wuxuu maamulaa laba boos oo sanduuqa furaha ah: kan koowaad (muqadas, waligiis lama tirtirin) iyo kan labaad (kaabta). Shabkani waxa uu tusinayaa booska firfircoon, beddela dookha, ama kor u qaada dugsiga sare ilaa hoose marka la eego codsi cad - oo wata kaydin iyo qoraal buuxa.
strings.btnIntegrityFix: 🔧 Dib u codso si badbaado leh
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Xaqiijinta daacadnimada: waxay hubisaa TEE furaha soo dejinta, duritaanka maktabadda ee gudaha keystore2, heerka burinta (CRL), caymiska liiska ilaalinta iyo gobolka RKP. Akhri-kaliya - waxba ma beddelo.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe dib u codso:

• Liiska ilaalinta waxa dib looga dhisay abka kasta oo la rakibay sanduuqa furaha waligiis lama taaban.

Sii wad?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Sanduuqa furaha: waxay tusinaysaa xaaladda boosaska koowaad iyo labaad waxayna beddelaan dookhyada dhexdooda. Asal ahaan (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) had iyo jeer waa la ilaaliyaa oo waligiis lama tirtirin. Horumarinta dugsiga sare ilaa hoose waxay u baahan tahay xaqiijin cad.
